carpet.rule.sulfurCubeGrowthTime.name: Sulfur Cube Growth Time
carpet.rule.sulfurCubeGrowthTime.desc: Sets the in-game seconds for a small Sulfur Cube to grow into a medium one; -1 keeps vanilla timing, which is 20 minutes; a positive integer overrides the duration for newly spawned or split small Sulfur Cubes; feeding acceleration remains vanilla
carpet.rule.enhancedFakePlayerRejoin.des: With Carpet TIS, preserve the saved vehicle and passengers on /player <name> rejoin and allow rejoin at a position, facing and dimension
carpet.rule.customJoinNotice.desc: Sends a configurable welcome message and server opening date when a player joins; configure with /fga joinNotice
carpet.rule.serverAnnouncements.desc: Controls announcements sent on player join or entry into a configured dimension and coordinate region
carpet.rule.playerPossession.name: Player Possession
carpet.rule.playerPossession.desc: Use /player <name> possess to control an online player or fake player without an FGA client
carpet.rule.playerPossession.extra.0: true: all players may control fake or real players
carpet.rule.playerPossession.extra.1: onlyfake: all players may control fake players only
carpet.rule.playerPossession.extra.2: opreal: regular players may control fake players; operators may control fake or real players
carpet.rule.playerPossession.extra.3: ops: only operators may control fake or real players
carpet.rule.playerPossession.extra.4: Carpet commandPlayer entry permission always applies
carpet.rule.playerPossession.extra.5: Function and main code are based on the PlayerControl mod, licensed under CC0-1.0, and fully server-side
carpet.rule.playerPossessionDistance.des: Limits the maximum same-dimension distance when starting possession; -1 disables the limit
carpet.rule.playerPossessionCrossDimensi: Allows possession to start or remain active when the two players are in different dimensions
carpet.rule.showControllerPrefix.name: Show Possession Names
carpet.rule.showControllerPrefix.desc: Shows red square brackets only after the controlled player name, containing the controller name in light gray
carpet.rule.permissionSwapsToo.name: Swap Permissions During Possession
carpet.rule.permissionSwapsToo.desc: true: the possessed player uses the controller's own command permissions
carpet.rule.permissionSwapsToo.extra.0: false: the possessed player uses the controlled player's command permissions
carpet.rule.permissionSwapsToo.extra.1: Only command permissions are affected; possession entry permissions, save ownership, and offline player data are unchanged
fga.possession.denied: You are not allowed to possess this player.
fga.possession.busy: This player is already participating in possession; automatic actions cannot run during possession.
fga.possession.unavailable: Both players must be alive and online.
fga.possession.missing: The target player is not online.
fga.possession.no_session: You are not participating in possession of that target.
fga.possession.failed: Possession could not be initialized. Your original body has been restored.
fga.possession.started: Swapped state with %s. Use /player %s possess stop to return.
fga.possession.watched: %s swapped body state with you; use /player %s possess stop to end possession.
fga.possession.ended: Possession ended. Your original state has been restored.
fga.possession.reconnect: Possession ended, but your client could not be synchronized. Please reconnect.
fga.possession.list_empty: There are no active possession relationships.
fga.possession.player_only: This query can only be run by a player.
fga.possession.query_missing: No online player matched that name.
fga.possession.status_none: That player is not participating in possession.
Allows QuickCraft clients to request schematic entity placement. The server validates reach, entity data, and materials before consuming materials and spawning the entity.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameLength.name: Fake Player Name Length
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNameLength.desc: Sets the maximum fake-player name length from 1 to 128; clients without FGA receive compatible aliases; from Minecraft 26.3, full names require the matching codec fix on both client and server, while earlier versions use the legacy long-name network path
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNamePresets.name: Custom Fake Player Presets
carpet.rule.fakePlayerNamePresets.desc: Customizes the fake-player name suggestions for /player
false: keeps Carpet default Steve and Alex
[name,name]: replaces the default presets while keeping online players and possession targets in suggestions
Only suggestions are affected; manually entered names are not restricted
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRangeControl.name: Fake Player Range Control
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRangeControl.desc: Enables area placement, block interaction, area breaking, continuous tasks, and basic pathfinding for fake players.
Allows multiplayer servers to accept players beyond server.properties max-players without changing ban, whitelist, or IP-ban checks; automatically effective when GCA fakePlayerResident is enabled.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerProfilePreload.des: Moves fake-player profile lookup off the server thread before spawning. Available on Minecraft 1.21 and newer.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerProfilePreload.ext: false: Keep Carpet's original synchronous profile lookup.
always: Preload every fake-player profile asynchronously before spawning.
adaptive: The first spawn remains synchronous. A second spawn within 30 seconds enables preloading for 2 minutes; each later spawn extends the window to 2 minutes.
carpet.rule.fgaUnicodeArgumentsSupport.d: Allows unquoted command arguments to contain non-English and other Unicode characters. This independent FGA rule does not conflict with YACA's rule.
carpet.rule.recipeBookAlwaysUnlocked.des: Gives every player all registered recipes on login with a one-minute per-player cooldown without discarding saved recipe unlock data
carpet.rule.enchantedGoldenCarrot.name: Enchanted Golden Carrot
carpet.rule.enchantedGoldenCarrot.desc: Adds two shapeless recipes: 8 gold ingots with 1 carrot, or 7 gold ingots with 1 regular golden carrot
Produces an enchanted-looking golden carrot that can be eaten at full hunger and restores hunger and saturation to 20
carpet.rule.lightSourceStonecuttingRecip: Allows beacons, glowstone, jack-o-lanterns, sea lanterns, frog lights, end rods, torches, candles, and other light-emitting blocks to be placed in the stonecutter and cut into minecraft:light blocks with light levels 1 through 15, producing 4 each time; 1.21.9+ also supports copper torches and all oxidized and waxed copper lantern variants
minecraft:light blocks of any light level can also be converted between each other in the stonecutter at a one-to-one rate
carpet.rule.lightBlockBreakable.name: Breakable Light Blocks
carpet.rule.lightBlockBreakable.desc: Survival players holding a light block can break light blocks
carpet.rule.lightBlockBreakable.extra.0: The client must have FGA installed to start survival breaking
tag.item.carpet-fga-addition.light_sourc: Light Emitting Blocks for Light Block Conversion
carpet.rule.inventoryAdvancementOptimiza: Uses exact item candidate indexing for inventory_changed advancements. false keeps vanilla behavior; exact preserves vanilla matching and falls back safely on inconsistencies.
carpet.rule.playerHealthDisplay.name: Player Health Display
carpet.rule.playerHealthDisplay.desc: Shows player health in the player list. true shows all players, false shows only for /log playerHealth subscribers, and nofake hides fake-player health.
carpet.rule.itemFrameBlockification.name: Item Frame Blockification
carpet.rule.itemFrameBlockification.desc: Removes item frames from server entity tick scheduling and validates support changes while preserving vanilla rendering, interaction, drops, maps, and comparator output
carpet.rule.fireworkMinecartBoost.name: Firework Minecart Boost
carpet.rule.fireworkMinecartBoost.desc: Lets players riding normal minecarts use firework rockets for configurable full-speed boosts followed by linear deceleration
carpet.rule.chainMinecartBinding.name: Chain Minecart Binding
carpet.rule.chainMinecartBinding.desc: Lets chains connect normal minecarts into persistent linear trains
carpet.rule.minecartFeatureCommandPermis: Controls access to firework minecart and chain train configuration commands
carpet.rule.vehicleStopOnDismount.name: Vehicle Stop On Dismount
carpet.rule.vehicleStopOnDismount.desc: Controls whether a vehicle immediately loses horizontal speed when its controlling player dismounts
carpet.rule.wanderingTraderNoDespawn.des: false keeps vanilla behavior; true prevents every wandering trader from despawning; controlled protects only traders matching the /villagerPerformance wanderingTrader name or block lists.
Restores the bee collision box from before Minecraft 26.2: 0.7 blocks wide and 0.6 blocks high.
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.name: Client Dimension IDs
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.desc: Maps the client-visible dimension IDs for the Overworld, Nether, and End. This separates minimap and Voxy data without changing server-side dimensions.
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.extra.0: Use [overworld,the_nether,the_end] or exactly three custom IDs in the same order. Missing namespaces default to minecraft.
carpet.rule.clientDimensionIds.extra.1: Fake-player spawning, teleportation, server saves, and modded server dimensions are unchanged. Reconnect after changing this rule.
carpet.rule.removeDialogWarning.name: Remove Command Confirmation Warning
carpet.rule.removeDialogWarning.desc: Removes the confirmation warning for server-sent run-command clicks and dialog actions. Only available on Minecraft 1.21.8 and newer.
carpet.rule.removeDialogWarning.extra.0: Warning: Enable only for servers whose command content you trust.
carpet.rule.villagerBreedingAnimalizatio: Allows shift-right-click feeding to give adult villagers breeding willingness and speed up baby villager growth like other animals.
false: Keep vanilla villager breeding only.
true: Allow both vanilla food pickup and direct player feeding.
only: Only direct player feeding grants breeding willingness.
Baby villagers consume one item per feeding; bread provides the same growth boost as four consecutive carrot, potato, or beetroot feedings.
carpet.rule.hostileMobInventoryAccess.de: Opens a hostile mob's six equipment slots by shift-right-clicking it with both hands empty.
carpet.rule.droppedItemStackLimit.name: Dropped Item Stack Limit
carpet.rule.droppedItemStackLimit.desc: Enables separately configured server-side stack limits for ground items, player inventories, and containers through /droppedItemStackLimit, up to 1000000000 items. false disables the feature; true allows everyone to manage it; ops or 0-4 set the manager permission level.
carpet.rule.droppedItemMergeDistance.des: Changes the horizontal search distance for merging ground item entities; -1 keeps vanilla 0.5 blocks. The vertical search range is unchanged.
carpet.rule.unlimitedFillCommands.name: Unlimited Fill Commands
carpet.rule.unlimitedFillCommands.desc: Removes the volume limit from /fill and /fillbiome. Chunks must still be loaded and all other vanilla checks remain active.
carpet.rule.preStackMobDeathDrops.name: Pre-stack Mob Death Drops
carpet.rule.preStackMobDeathDrops.desc: Immediately pre-stacks compatible death drops from selected mob entity types. Use false or a list such as [zombified_piglin,zombie].
Entity IDs without a namespace use minecraft. Players, experience, block drops, and unselected mobs are unchanged.
Compatible drops from later selected-mob deaths in the same tick and configured range merge into the first entity.
carpet.rule.preStackMobDeathDropsRange.d: Sets the legacy three-dimensional same-tick merge range from 0 to 16 blocks; default is 1.5. Migrate to per-entity ranges with /dropPreStack.
carpet.rule.preStackDroppedItems.name: Drop Pre-stacking
carpet.rule.preStackDroppedItems.desc: Enables entity-death and block-drop pre-stacking configured by /dropPreStack. New command entries default to range 1.
carpet.rule.zombifiedPiglinDropReduction: Removes selected drops from zombified piglins.
goldEquipment: Remove gold armor, golden swords, and golden spears.
all: Remove both gold equipment and rotten flesh.
Gold nuggets and ingots are not affected.
carpet.rule.entityDropRemoval.name: Custom Entity Drop Removal
carpet.rule.entityDropRemoval.desc: Configures death drops to remove per entity; false disables the command, true allows everyone, and ops or 0-4 controls configuration access
carpet.rule.entityDropRemoval.extra.0: Use /entityDropRemoval set <entity id> <item id> for an item, or allEquipment for all six equipment slots.
carpet.rule.entityDropRemoval.extra.1: Item entries filter loot-table and equipment drops; allEquipment does not remove same-named loot-table items.
carpet.rule.piglinBarterItemExclusions.d: Use /fga piglinBarterItemExclusions list to view and edit the current piglin barter loot table
carpet.rule.piglinBarterItemExclusions.e: Entries can be edited by clicking the list; totals below 100% leave the remainder as empty trades, and totals above 100% are normalized proportionally
carpet.rule.villagerPerformanceOptimizat: Enables villager performance optimization and controls access to /villagerPerformance: true for everyone, ops for OP level 2, or 1-4 for a minimum permission level.
Use /villagerPerformance help for clickable trade and Hero of the Village gift configuration.
carpet.rule.spectatorFreeTeleport.name: Free Teleport Access
carpet.rule.spectatorFreeTeleport.desc: Controls permission-free /tp and /teleport access: false keeps vanilla, true allows spectators to teleport themselves, and full grants complete teleport commands in every game mode
false: Keep vanilla teleport permission requirements

true: Spectators can teleport themselves, including across dimensions by following a player or choosing a dimension and position; they cannot teleport other entities, and TIS or AMS cheat prevention also restricts OP spectators

full: Players in every game mode can use complete /tp and /teleport commands, including cross-dimension teleports, multiple targets, and teleporting other players or entities; bypasses TIS/AMS permission wrappers only for these commands
carpet-fga-addition.command.spectatorFre: The destination is outside the world bounds
Could not teleport to the destination
carpet.rule.PlayerTpEndControl.name: Player End Portal Teleport Control
carpet.rule.PlayerTpEndControl.desc: Controls player teleportation through End portals, End exit portals, and End gateways: false keeps vanilla behavior, true blocks all player portal teleports, and control uses per-player preferences managed by /playertpend
carpet.rule.namedEnderPearlTeleport.name: Named Ender Pearl Player Teleport
carpet.rule.namedEnderPearlTeleport.desc: Named ender pearls teleport the online player with the matching custom name; when no matching player is online, the named pearl does not teleport anyone
carpet.rule.PlayerTpEndControl.extra.0: In control mode, missing preferences allow every portal type by default. This server-side rule never blocks non-player entities.
carpet.rule.grassBonemealAnyFlower.name: Any Flower Bone Meal
carpet.rule.grassBonemealAnyFlower.desc: Lets bone meal grow any flower on grass blocks in any biome; flowers still need enough light to survive, and tall flowers generate both halves
carpet.rule.grassBonemealAnyFlower.extra: false: keeps vanilla behavior (only the current biome's flowers)
true: grows any of the small flowers obtainable through vanilla bonemeal
all: additionally grows the tall flowers (sunflower, lilac, rose bush, peony)
carpet.rule.boneMealMaxEfficiency.name: Maximum Bone Meal Efficiency
carpet.rule.boneMealMaxEfficiency.desc: Fully grows saplings, bamboo, sea pickles, and other plants that can grow through multiple stages from one bone meal
carpet.rule.fullShulkerBoxCrafting.name: Full Shulker Box Crafting
carpet.rule.fullShulkerBoxCrafting.desc: Crafts shulker boxes of one item through matching ordinary crafting and stonecutter recipes; only64 requires exact vanilla-full boxes and whole-box outputs, any accepts any content amount and crafts one click's worth with a partial final box
carpet-fga-addition.fullShulkerBoxCrafti: Not enough empty shulker boxes; %s more required
Every input shulker box must hold one identical item (full boxes in only64 mode)
Unstackable items cannot be used in full shulker box crafting
Input box capacities differ and cannot be fully consumed without leftovers
Input boxes must contain the same number of items
The box content count must divide evenly by what one craft of this recipe consumes
The recipe output is unstackable and cannot fill a shulker box
The recipe output does not form a whole number of full shulker boxes
The recipe has an unstackable remaining item
The remaining recipe items do not form whole full shulker boxes
This craft would produce too many shulker boxes
carpet.rule.fakePlayerItemSort.name: Fake Player Item Sorting
carpet.rule.fakePlayerItemSort.desc: Enables fake-player inventory sorting; use /fakePlayerItemSort to manage mode and sorter settings
carpet-fga-addition.command.fakePlayerIt: Rebuild every cached sorter inventory. Tasks run at a limited rate.
Queued %s sorter routes for rate-limited rebuild.
carpet.rule.voidWorldGeneration.name: Void World Generation
carpet.rule.voidWorldGeneration.desc: Makes newly generated chunks empty while retaining biome and structure-location data
carpet.rule.terrainRegenerationCommandPe: Controls access to terrain regeneration and void clearing commands
carpet.rule.endGatewayRegeneration.name: End Gateway Regeneration
carpet.rule.endGatewayRegeneration.desc: Regenerates destroyed vanilla End gateways using only the gateway block and its own data; surrounding blocks are unchanged.
Use /droppedItemStackLimit mode inventory or container to configure backpack and container limits separately.
carpet.rule.babyMobNoGrowth.name: Baby Mob No Growth
carpet.rule.babyMobNoGrowth.desc: Prevents all baby mobs or baby mobs with an exact case-sensitive custom name from growing, including tadpoles
carpet.rule.resilientPlants.name: Resilient Plants
carpet.rule.resilientBlocks.name: Resilient Blocks
carpet.rule.resilientBlocks.desc: Configured blocks skip the below-block support check when placed and ignore block updates instead of checking their own state
carpet.rule.resilientPlants.desc: Lets matching plants ignore vanilla survival restrictions and be placed without normal support
carpet.rule.comparatorThroughBlocks.name: Comparator Container Signal Through Blocks
carpet.rule.comparatorThroughBlocks.desc: Lets comparators read an analog container signal through configured front blocks such as [chain,piston] without changing their other redstone behavior
carpet.rule.comparatorThroughBlocks.extr: g false: keeps vanilla behavior and does not read through blocks; [block_id]: reads the container behind the comparator only when the front block is listed
g Separate block IDs with commas; minecraft is assumed when the namespace is omitted, for example [chain,piston]
carpet.rule.shulkerBedrockDuplication.de: A shulker killed by a shulker bullet, its own or another shulker's, always respawns a new shulker at the same spot, like Bedrock Edition
carpet.rule.shulkerBedrockLooting.name: Shulker Bedrock Looting
carpet.rule.shulkerBedrockLooting.desc: Shulker shell drops follow Bedrock Edition looting: a flat 50% chance to drop, dropping 1 to 1+Looting shells uniformly
carpet.rule.shulkerAttackArmorStand.name: Shulker Attack Armor Stand
carpet.rule.shulkerAttackArmorStand.desc: Allows shulkers to target and shoot armor stands: true targets all, pumpkin targets only those wearing a carved pumpkin on the head
carpet.rule.deepslateStonecuttingRecipes: Makes deepslate behave in the stonecutter like it does in 26.1+
carpet.rule.anvilNoPriorWorkPenalty.name: Remove Anvil Enchantment Penalty
carpet.rule.anvilNoPriorWorkPenalty.desc: Removes the anvil prior-work penalty and too-expensive limit while keeping enchantment conflicts and material costs
carpet.rule.enchantmentLevelLimitIncreas: false or 0 keeps vanilla limits; enter N directly to increase enchantment maximums, capped at stored level 255; Aqua Affinity, Silk Touch, Flame, Infinity, Channeling, Multishot, Mending, Curse of Binding, and Curse of Vanishing always remain at level I
carpet.rule.enchantmentLevelAddition.des: Adds matching enchantment levels in an anvil, so 2+2 becomes 4; an input at the maximum gives no result, while sums above it are capped at the maximum
carpet.rule.fireAspectOnTools.name: Fire Aspect Tool Smelting
carpet.rule.fireAspectOnTools.desc: Mining tools can receive Fire Aspect; Fire Aspect I smelts drops once and Fire Aspect II smelts them twice; tools cannot receive Fire Aspect from an enchanting table
carpet.rule.soulSpeedNoDurability.name: Soul Speed No Durability Cost
carpet.rule.soulSpeedNoDurability.desc: Soul Speed no longer damages boots while moving on soul sand, soul soil, or other compatible blocks
carpet.rule.thornsNoDurability.name: Thorns No Durability Cost
carpet.rule.thornsNoDurability.desc: Thorns no longer damages armor when its retaliation effect triggers
carpet.rule.experienceLevelCost.name: Flat Experience Level Costs
carpet.rule.experienceLevelCost.desc: false keeps vanilla costs; 29-30 makes level 30+ cost the same as level 29 to 30; 0-1 makes every level cost the same as level 0 to 1
carpet.rule.woodStonecuttingRecipes.name: Wood Stonecutting Recipes
carpet.rule.woodStonecuttingRecipes.desc: Allows wood products to be crafted in the stonecutter
carpet.rule.villagerDoNotCraftBread.name: Villagers Do Not Craft Bread
carpet.rule.villagerDoNotCraftBread.desc: Makes farmer villagers handle wheat like 26.3+ by no longer crafting it into bread
Lets villagers wait for and complete profession upgrades without closing the trading screen, like 26.3+
carpet.rule.villagerMinimumTradePrice.de: Uses the minimum vanilla random input price for newly assigned villager professions while preserving demand, reputation, and Hero of the Village modifiers; only applies when an unassigned villager is newly assigned a profession
carpet.rule.villagerOnlyMaxEnchantmentBo: Villagers Only Sell Max-Level Enchanted Books
Newly generated enchanted books promote their rolled enchantments directly to the target level
onlyvanilla: promotes to the vanilla maximum for enchanted-book trades
more: allows the level configured by enchantmentLevelLimitIncrease
Only affects trades newly generated when a villager gains a profession or levels up
carpet.rule.villagerOnlyMaxEnchantmentEq: Villagers Only Sell Max-Level Enchanted Weapons and Equipment
Newly generated enchanted weapons and equipment promote their rolled enchantments directly to the target level

onlyvanilla: uses the cap calculated from vanilla equipment trades' 5 to 19 enchanting power and item enchantability, so Efficiency, Sharpness, and similar enchantments do not become level V when vanilla equipment trades cannot reach V
more: allows the level configured by enchantmentLevelLimitIncrease
Unenchanted equipment and other trades are unaffected; only newly generated trades are changed
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.name: Player Load Distance
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.desc: Controls per-player chunk sending and tracking distance without changing simulation distance
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.extra.0: Use /playerLoadDistance help; temporary overrides expire on restart unless persistent is appended
carpet.rule.playerLoadDistance.extra.1: -1 keeps only the center chunk weakly loaded, 0 keeps the center strongly loaded and a 3x3 weak area, 1-32 sets a radius, and none removes player loading
carpet.rule.mapLoadCommandPermission.ext: true: allows every player to use them
ops: requires OP level 2 or higher
carpet.rule.foodCommandPermission.name: Food Clear Command Permission
carpet.rule.foodCommandPermission.desc: Controls access to /food clear and /fga food clear
true: allows every source to clear its own or specified players' food
onlyself: non-OP players can clear only themselves; OPs can target players
ops: requires OP level 2 or higher; 0-4: sets the minimum permission level
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerPlayerMultiplier: Counts each matching trial participant as the configured number of players for trial mobs and rewards
Range 1-10000, default 100; 1 keeps the vanilla one-player scale
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerPlayerFilter.des: Selects players affected by the trial multiplier: false, true, bot_, or a custom name prefix
carpet.rule.trialSpawnerPlayerFilter.ext: false disables scaling; true matches everyone; other values use a case-sensitive name-prefix match
carpet.rule.trialStopCommandPermission.d: Enables and controls the /trialStop stop-and-refresh command with false, true, ops, or permission levels 0-4
carpet.fga.trialStop.clear: Remove only mobs tracked by this spawner
carpet.rule.netherPortalNoLight.name: Nether Portal No Light
carpet.rule.netherPortalNoLight.desc: Controls Nether portal block light: false keeps vanilla behavior, true disables light from all portals, and onlynew disables light from portals created while the rule is active; disabling the rule does not actively refresh existing portals
carpet.fga.food.cleared.targets: Cleared food and saturation for %s players

carpet.fga.fake_player_item_sort.sort_pr: Set /carpet fakePlayerProfilePreload to always or adaptive first.
